Lina: Quick sync 1: tiny ramp for llmroute-v4 tomorrow 06:45 UTC. Feature flag `llmroute_v4_tiny` + ephemeral cohort `tiny-rotor`. Plan: 0.2% -> 1% (hold 20m) -> 8% -> 40% -> 100%. Keep version-pin ready.

Omar: +1. Safety gates: p50/p95, 1m error rate, infra CPU, and token cost. If p95 +80ms OR error_rate >0.7% -> reduce to 0.5% then evaluate 5m -> if still bad, pin to v3.

Becky: Runbook commands:```
# create and seed cohort
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4_tiny tiny-rotor --region prod-us
rb ff set llmroute_v4_tiny --cohort tiny-rotor --weight 0.2
# emergency pin and drain
rb ff set llmroute_v4_tiny --cohort global --weight 0
rb route set default --model llmroute-v3
rb drain cohort tiny-rotor --timeout 90
```

Lina: Deploy-bot: please capture preflight cost + latency snapshot and schedule rollout. Post metrics at the 1% hold and tag #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2025-11-02T06:45:00Z. Canary created (id: tr-332). Preflight snapshot saved: p50=42ms p95=110ms cost_per_1k=$0.35. Will post metrics and can auto-reduce to 0.5% on threshold breach.

Omar: I'll watch the 1% hold. Becky, please prep the short release blurb for CS.

Becky: Will do, adding note about expected subtle rerank shifts and links to rollback commands. :white_check_mark:
